info.name: NOUS Backend
info.description:
NOUS backend API. Base URL, tokens and ids live in collection variables.

Happy path for a fresh run: Auth > Register, Resend OTP (captures {{otp}} in dev), Verify OTP (captures {{token}}), then Login. Admin requests need the admin token from Auth > Login (admin), which also needs the x-admin-access-token header.

Content APIs run top down: Courses > Levels > Subjects > Chapters. Each create captures its id into a collection variable, so the child folders work without editing anything.

Auth is collection level bearer {{token}}, public endpoints override it with No Auth.

Content rules baked into these requests: everything a student sees is active, the admin owns courses/levels/subjects/chapters/past papers/syllabus, and a student may only upload notes. Making a node inactive (or deleting it) pushes every descendant to inactive, deletes never cascade as deletes. Every PDF name is unique across the whole system.

item.name: Student Flow
item.description: The student journey in order: courses > levels > subjects > chapters, then past papers at subject level, and syllabus / past papers / notes inside a chapter. Each step stores the first row's id, so running the folder top to bottom needs no manual input. Run Auth > Login (student) first.

request.description: Student landing screen. Only active courses come back, whatever is asked for.
Student picked a course. Active levels of that course only.

item.name: 3. Subjects of the selected course + level

request.description: Subject screen shows chapters and a Past Papers entry, see 4b.
Past Papers tapped straight from the subject: everything under course + level + subject, including past papers that are tagged to a chapter.
Syllabus card inside a chapter.
Past Papers card inside a chapter: narrowed to that chapter only.
Notes card inside a chapter. Shows notes uploaded by every student, not just this one.

The only thing a student may upload. Upload the PDF through /upload/cloudinary first, then pass its file key here. It becomes active straight away, so every student browsing this chapter sees it. Names are unique across all PDFs in the system.
Same notes endpoint narrowed to the signed in student's own uploads, for a My notes screen. A student cannot pass uploadedBy to read someone else's, it is ignored.
Public signup. Creates the account as pending and emails an OTP. profileIcon must be a relative key from the upload API, not an http URL.
In dev/localhost the OTP comes back in the response, so it is captured into {{otp}}.
Verifies the email and flips a pending account to active. Returns a token.
Email must already be verified through the OTP API, otherwise 401 email_not_verified.
Admin login additionally requires the x-admin-access-token header.
The signed in user's own profile. This is what a client calls on relaunch to rehydrate the session from a stored token. Password is never included.
resetToken comes back from Verify OTP.
NOTE: this endpoint still validates userType against ["user", "coach"], which no longer exist in USER_TYPES, so it fails until updated.
IP allowlisted + requires the x-admin-access-token-signup header.
Phone OTP path. The account must already exist with this phone number.
Admin only. name is required and unique among non-deleted courses.

Admin + student. Students always see active only. status accepts active | inactive | deleted (admin only). meta.courseCount carries totalRecord/active/inactive/deleted, and every row carries contentCount { activeLevels, activeSubjects }.
status accepts active | inactive only, deleted is set by the delete API.
Soft delete, sets status to deleted.
courseId filter also scopes meta.levelCount. Rows carry contentCount { activeSubjects, activeChapters } and their parent course.
Rows carry contentCount { activeChapters } and the level with its course nested. contentCount is { activeChapters, activePastPapers }, which is exactly what the subject screen lists.
chapterNumber must be a whole number >= 1 and unique inside the subject.

Sorted by chapterNumber ascending. Rows carry the full subject > level > course chain. Each row carries contentCount { activeSyllabus, activeNotes, activePastPapers } - the numbers behind the three cards on the chapter screen, so no extra call is needed.
chapterId is optional for past papers. Left out, the paper sits on the subject.
Admin may pass status active | inactive | deleted, a student is always forced to active. meta.pdfCount carries totalRecord/active/inactive/deleted.
status accepts active | inactive only.
A syllabus PDF always belongs to a chapter, course/level/subject are derived from it.
Admin management view. Every row carries the full hierarchy (course, level, subject, chapter) plus the student who uploaded it. uploadedBy filters to one student.
Only an admin may edit or deactivate a note, a student can just upload.
Multipart field name is files, up to 10. Returns { file, fileUrl, fileExtension, publicId, resourceType }. Save the relative `file` key on records like profileIcon.
Accepts the relative key, the bare public id, or the full delivery URL.
Same Cloudinary handler, kept so existing clients posting to /upload/aws keep working.
Returns 503 azure_storage_not_configured unless the AZURE_STORAGE_* vars are set.
Stores under /uploads on the server. Multipart field name is file.
Destructive. Wipes the named collection.
